nodes.label: desktop memory - the facet semantic framework research grounding

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. Research grounding from 2026-05-30 for defining the v2 facets as real semantic dimensions rather than token extractors, on the premise that the v1 facets - topic, entities, activity, temporal, evidence - capture only the ideational strand and degraded into shallow extraction. The four load-bearing frameworks: SFL metafunctions (Halliday), where every clause carries three strands of meaning simultaneously and at equal status - ideational as experience, interpersonal as stance and relationship, textual as discourse role - so the v1 facets are almost entirely ideational with interpersonal and textual missing; frame semantics and thematic roles (Fillmore, Jackendoff), where meaning is a frame with participants in roles, so entities should capture participant ROLES rather than raw identifiers; TAM, where temporal meaning decomposes into tense, aspect and modality, which is the user's 'temporal was never about dates' with dates as structure and tense-aspect-modality as the temporal facet; and Appraisal theory (Martin and White), grounding evidence as evidentiality and sourcing rather than URLs and supplying the missing stance dimension. Six independent lineages converge on the same dimensional structure - Ranganathan PMEST, neo-Davidsonian and AMR event semantics, 5W1H, SFL, TAM, Appraisal plus evidentiality, and RST and speech-acts - de-duplicated into a three-tier convergent model. CANON_AUDIT.md 6.5 verdict: STALE - this entry declares the facet set settled as topic, process, stance, communicative-function, time, against two other desktop files declaring different settled sets
